finding.sink: ARGS_POST key json.a.b (payload shadowed); backend JSON parser still uses the nested payload

finding.guards_checked: Recursion depth limit (json.go:106-109, default 1024); validity check gjson.Valid (json.go:90) passes for this input; no collision detection. Raw JSON only exposed to @validateSchema. Not verified by execution.
